reply.thought: I will list orders to identify customers in this batch, then check each customer's net_balance from the shared ledger to ensure refunds are applied, and finally record one payout per customer.

I see 3 customers (acme, birch, cobalt) with orders 270/273, 271/274, and 272/275. Next I will fetch Alpha’s refunds list and then use net_balance per customer to ensure refunds are correctly reflected before paying.
Refunds reported by Alpha match the provided applied list; next I will verify each customer's net_balance from the shared ledger and then record one payout per customer based on that net balance.
I will now get net_balance for the remaining customers (birch and cobalt) to confirm their correct net amounts before recording payouts.
I will fetch net_balance for cobalt as well, then record one payout per customer for the exact net amounts.
Refunds are reported as done and net_balance for acme, birch, and cobalt are available. I will record one payout per customer for the net amounts.
